name: Dark Bench
concept: Matte graphite tools on an infinite dotted canvas — one node in focus, the rest racked away.

type.families: Geometric or humanist sans at small sizes (Inter, General Sans). Monospace for identifiers, ports and payload snippets.
type.hierarchy: Node title 13/18 medium · node body 12/16 regular · port label 10/13 mono · canvas heading 20/26 medium. Everything is small — the canvas is the subject, not the type.
type.usage: Sentence case. Monospace for any machine-facing string. Truncate aggressively inside nodes; the node is a summary, not a document.

tokens.texture: Matte and flat — this is the dark style with no glow. Cards are solid `--surface` with a 1px `--line` border and no shadow beyond a tight `0 2px 8px rgb(0 0 0 / .5)`. The ground is a dotted canvas: `radial-gradient(var(--dot) 1px, transparent 1px)` at a 24px grid. Connections are 2px bezier curves in `--muted` that turn `--accent` when active, ending in solid triangular arrowheads or small port dots.
tokens.layout: An infinite canvas, not a page. Nodes are 240-320px wide cards placed freely and wired together; a floating toolbar pill and a minimap dock over the canvas. 4px scale inside nodes, 12px node padding, 10px radius. Presentation trick: photograph the canvas at a slight tilt with everything but one node racked out of focus, so a single node reads as the subject.

best_for: any product whose object is a graph

image_recipe.template:
[SUBJECT: describe the subject in one clause — e.g. "a stack of shipping containers", "a single ceramic cup", "an abstract network of nodes"]

Rendered as macro photograph of a dark screen at a slight tilt, shallow depth of field.

STYLE — apply all of the following, they are not optional:
- near-black #0B0B0B ground with a faint regular dot grid
- matte graphite panels, absolutely no glow or bloom
- one green #3FBF52 as the only saturated colour, on connector lines only
- shallow depth of field — one element sharp, the rest falling off
- slight perspective tilt, cool neutral colour temperature

NEGATIVE SPACE: The out-of-focus region should occupy the outer half of the frame.

DO NOT INCLUDE: neon glow, iridescence, warm colour casts, flat orthographic vector, light backgrounds, lens flare.
